annotations.text:
The account stop stopped being a door.

It opened the drawer on the pilot page. It opens a list in place now, exactly the way ZONE and SHIP already do: same upward panel, same row states, same press-again-to-shut. Shipped as decision 99, and the pilot page went with it.

The list holds only the account acts. No career, no stats: the career is the site's, at /pilots.

Acts on the account you are stand above a rule; ways of being somebody else stand below it. A guest reads SIGN UP in the caution color with KEEP YOUR POINTS beside it, then NEW NAME, then LOG IN. A claimed pilot reads SET PASSWORD and NEW NAME over the rule, LOG OFF under it. The stop wears a dot while a guest has something a lost account would cost them.

What changed on the way in.

SIGN UP and CLAIM ACCOUNT were two rows here and are one act: the server has one endpoint, /v1/claim, and it puts a password on the account this client was already handed. So one row, and the rule moved up.

The offer wears the caution color rather than a green. The green belonged to an invite band that went with friends; the caution color is what the guest band and the stop's dot are written in.

Still open: what a row press opens is drawn nowhere here. LOG IN and both password acts raise cards, which stand over the landing with no panel behind them.
